newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank says repo tender drains 62 bln SKR.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank says repo tender drains 62 bln SKR.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday that the morning's seven day reverse repurchase operation drained 62 billion crowns from the market.
The reverse repurchase operation was set at a fixed rate of 5.05 percent and will run from September 25 to October 2, replacing an operation that drained 62 billion crowns from the market.
The Riksbank said 14.16 percent of bids for the tender were allocated.
